next.reason: Without REPLACING, 1985 sets alphabetic, alphanumeric, alphanumeric-edited items to spaces and numeric, numeric-edited to zeros as by MOVE. §2023:14.9.20.4 GR5 c)4 ('Neither the REPLACING phrase nor the VALUE phrase is specified') makes each item a receiving-operand, §2023:14.9.20.4 GR6 c) sends 'Figurative constant alphanumeric SPACES' or ZEROES by the same categories, §2023:14.9.20.4 GR4 by implicit MOVE. VALUE and DEFAULT are phrases 1985 lacks.
